candidates.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
verified_facts: Polygons show position and indicative extent of registered property.
INSPIRE ID relates a polygon to a registered title.
Registered-title land extent cannot be established from INSPIRE Index Polygons alone.
semantic_limits: Exact ID match is not an exact legal-boundary claim.

candidates.name: Download Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
verified_facts: New files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
semantic_limits: Fresh publication does not change the indicative legal-boundary status of the geometry.

candidates.name: Technical guidance for GML files
verified_facts: HMLR data is captured against British National Grid.
BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15m.
semantic_limits: Exact measurement must stay in native BNG; web reprojection is display-only.

candidates.name: National Polygon dataset - Technical specification
verified_facts: Index polygons provide an index showing indicative location of a registered title.
Title plan and register record the general position of boundaries unless an exact boundary has been determined.
semantic_limits: INSPIRE subset should not be presented as a determined exact boundary without separate title evidence.
